test_modes.name: Link bring-up
test_modes.purpose: Exercise the ErrorReset..Run handshake and NULL/FCT exchange at the target rate.

test_modes.name: Loopback / BER
test_modes.purpose: Physical-layer characterization of the LVDS Data/Strobe pairs and DS decoding.

test_modes.name: Error injection
test_modes.purpose: Inject parity / disconnect / escape / credit errors and confirm ErrorReset recovery.

test_modes.name: Time-Code exercise
test_modes.purpose: Broadcast Time-Codes and verify forwarding and tick generation.

spec_provided_observability.name: Link state
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Observes the exchange FSM state (ErrorReset / ErrorWait / Ready / Started / Connecting / Run).

spec_provided_observability.name: Error status
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Indicates disconnect, parity, escape, and credit errors per link.

spec_provided_observability.name: Credit / FCT status
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Outstanding credit and FCT counts for flow-control observability.

spec_provided_observability.name: Router status (port 0)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Per-port link state, routing-table contents, and error/status registers via RMAP / port-0 packets.

spec_provided_observability.name: Time-Code value
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Current 6-bit time value and tick for time-distribution checking.

spec_provided_observability.name: EOP / EEP
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Packet termination type indicates normal vs error end of packet.

error_detection_mechanisms: Odd parity per character detects single-bit character corruption.
Disconnect error detects loss of the far end (gap > ~850 ns).
Escape error detects an invalid ESC sequence (ESC+ESC or ESC+EOP/EEP).
Credit error detects an N-Char received/sent with no credit.
EEP marks a packet truncated by a network error.
Re-running ErrorReset -> Run resynchronizes the link after any error.

interrupt_or_event_sources.trigger: Disconnect / parity / escape / credit error returns the link to ErrorReset.
An EOP/EEP terminates a received packet.
A valid Time-Code increments system time.

notes: SpaceWire exposes its protocol-level test/debug surface through the link state machine, per-link error status (disconnect / parity / escape / credit), credit/FCT counts, EOP/EEP packet termination, the router configuration port (port 0, via RMAP), and Time-Code observability, plus physical-layer loopback / BER. Chip-level JTAG / scan / BIST remain implementation / SoC concerns.
